tool.title: Lower the tangles in ArchiMate views: re-route lines and swap same-size boxes in a row
tool.description: Searches for a less tangled drawing of each view: a line may be re-routed straight or orthogonally (an L, or a Z through a free lane between boxes), and two same-size boxes in the same parent and row or column may swap places. A change is kept only if it lowers crossings + lines through boxes + lines drawn on top of each other. Without `--apply` it reports before and after per view; with it, the model is written back in place, only the moved boxes' bounds and the re-routed lines' bendpoints changing.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The `.archimate` file (plain XML or Archi's zipped archive).

inputs.name: view
inputs.description: One view, by its Archi id (`id-<hex>`) or its page slug (e.g. `1-central-health-workforce-registry`). A slug, not free text, so no shell payload can ride on it. Absent: every view in the model.

inputs.name: routes-only
inputs.description: Never move a box; only re-route lines.

inputs.name: apply
inputs.description: Write the model back in place.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: Print JSON instead of one line per view.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Per view: tangles before and after, and the swaps and routes made.

selection.when: After drawing or changing an ArchiMate view, before committing it: run it, look at the drawing, keep what reads better (skill `archimate-models`).
selection.limits: A greedy search, one line or one swap at a time: it lowers tangles but does not find the best layout, never adds, resizes or regroups boxes, and leaves lines that end on lines, or share both ends with another line, as they are. The author still looks at the result.
selection.cost: Seconds for a large view (about 8 s for 20 views). No network, no JVM.
